Adding a status page to the directory? Edit only directory.yml, fill in this template and tick
every box below. An automatic check posts an overview with a preview of your entry; the maintainer

themselves. For any other change, delete this template and describe the change instead.

## Checklist

- [ ] I changed only `directory.yml` (DIRECTORY.md, the README table and the directory page are generated after merging).
- [ ] I added the entry at the end of its section and did not edit or remove other entries.
- [ ] The project is open source with a licence file, and its repository is public and not archived (or, for a status page, it is a service that research software depends on).
- [ ] The `live` address opens a page that shows it working, without signing in.
- [ ] My wording follows the [directory style guide](https://github.com/sr-dash/status/blob/main/docs/directory-style-guide.md): plain text, a capital first letter, no full stop at the end of `how`, `watches` or `about`, and no marketing words.
- [ ] I have read the [code of conduct](https://github.com/sr-dash/status/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
